newsitem.title: USA: Mellon Q4 provision rises for credit cards.
newsitem.headline: Mellon Q4 provision rises for credit cards.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said on Friday that the increase in its fourth quarter credit loss privision to $80 million from $35 million the previous fourth quarter was related to covering credit card loans.
Net credit losses in the fourth quarter of 1996 were $36 million, down from $138 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
According to Mellon, the decrease resulted from the $106 million credit loss recorded on the accelerated resolution credit card portfolio in the fourth quarter of 1995.
